svg.title: DESI coadd spectral HDUs
svg.desc: Five HDUs per camera arm (B, R, Z) showing array shapes and descriptions for wavelength, flux, ivar, mask, and resolution.
svg.text: SPECTRAL HDUs · HDUs 3–17 · five HDUs per camera · 1704 targets each
DESI's spectrograph splits light into three wavelength ranges. Each camera produces five HDUs at the same level in the FITS file — they are peers, not a sub-hierarchy.
The wavelength axis (first dimension) differs per camera. The fiber axis (second dimension, 1704) is shared across all three cameras
and aligns row-for-row with FIBERMAP and SCORES.
